title: User-reported bug confirmed at the code level: one hardcoded RRXR/RRRX condition-number crosswalk applied to all subjects, no V182o-specific mapping. Independent data verification of the correct V182o mapping was inconclusive.

claims.text: jnwb/session.py's get_epochs() and scripts/archive_oneoff/precompute_tfr_arrays.py's CONDITION_NUMBERS both hardcode the identical condition-name to task_condition_number mapping (RRXR=[35,37,39,41], RRRX=[36,38,40]+range(42,51)) with NO subject/animal branch -- applied uniformly to C31o, V198o, and V182o sessions alike. This is the single source of truth for every downstream script that resolves RRXR/RRRX onsets, including classify_omission_units_grand.py's Q2 ('knows WHEN') test via precompute_condition_onsets -> session.get_epochs.
claims.receipt: grep + Read of jnwb/session.py lines 228-237 and scripts/archive_oneoff/precompute_tfr_arrays.py lines 40-53; both dicts are textually identical, no per-animal conditional logic anywhere in either file

claims.text: For C31o and V198o, the is_omission column directly flags the omitted event row, and cross-referencing against task_condition_number confirms the current code's mapping is correct: cond 35/37/39/41 omit stimulus_number=4 (p3, slot 3, matching RRXR); cond 36/38/40/42-50 omit stimulus_number=5 (p4, slot 4, matching RRRX). No bug for these two subjects.
claims.receipt: python h5py check on sub-C31o_ses-230816_rec.nwb using is_omission==1 & correct==1, grouped by task_condition_number: cond 35/37/39/41 -> {4.0: N}; cond 36/38/40/42..50 -> {5.0: N}, exactly matching CONDITION_NUMBERS

claims.text: V182o sessions have no is_omission column (confirmed by column listing) and use 'oddball_status' instead, which does NOT behave as a simple omission flag: oddball_status equals task_condition_number at stimulus_number=5 for EVERY tested condition number from 1-50 with no exceptions, which is more consistent with an end-of-trial/completion code than a true per-condition omission-slot marker. The 'codes' field is a plain sequential per-stimulus-number code (100-104), uninformative. The 'contrast' field is uniformly 0.8 across stimulus_number 2-5 regardless of condition, also uninformative. None of the four fields checked (is_omission [absent], oddball_status, codes, contrast) let this session independently re-derive which slot each V182o condition number actually omits.
claims.receipt: python h5py checks on sub-V182o_ses-260629.nwb and sub-V182o_ses-260702.nwb: oddball_status==task_condition_number fires at stimulus_number=5.0 for all of cond 1-50 in both sessions (100% uniform, no cond-specific variation) -- inconsistent with it being a real per-condition omission-slot signal

issues: User (domain expert, direct knowledge of task design) states V182o's actual mapping is RRXR=35-42, RRRX=43-50 (contiguous split) vs C31o/V198o's interleaved 35/37/39/41 vs 36/38/40/42-50 split. This session could not independently confirm or refute that specific claim from the NWB event-table fields checked. Needs either: (a) the user's source for this mapping (task-generator script, codebook, prior analysis) so it can be implemented directly, or (b) identification of which NWB field actually encodes the omitted slot for V182o sessions specifically.

If confirmed, this bug would affect: jnwb.session.get_epochs() and precompute_tfr_arrays.py for ANY RRXR/RRRX-based analysis on V182o sessions -- notably classify_omission_units_grand.py's Q2 ('knows WHEN', position-encoding test) for V182o units in omission_grand_units.csv, and any future figure/analysis selecting RRXR/RRRX trials for V182o. Figures 4-7 built this session do NOT use RRXR/RRRX at all (only RXRR/RRRR/AXAB/BXBA), so they are unaffected regardless of how this resolves.
